name: regression_false_when_observed_meets_target
note: Observed meets the criterion's target under 'gte' — success, no regression.

name: regression_true_when_observed_below_baseline
note: Observed is below both baseline and target — a clear regression.

name: regression_true_when_partial_improvement_still_misses_target
note: Design decision: check_regression evaluates observed against the criterion's target/comparison only — baseline is context, not part of the pass/fail check. An observed value of 4 is an improvement over the baseline of 3, but still fails 'gte' against the target of 5, so this counts as a regression (fail-closed: partial progress is not success).
